results.case: D-04 one-page summary plus a separate appendix with sources
results.detail: the 180 s window closed with no answer; the gateway state at that moment reported active_agents = 1, so the product was still working on the request when the window ended

results.case: D-11 styled report with headings, table of contents, page numbers and appendix
results.detail: the tester refused at admission because the independent gate requires a quiescent gateway with active_agents = 0; the product was still busy with D-04, so no run record was created and nothing was sent
results.counted_as: not pass, not fail, no effect

what_this_shows: the admission gate that requires active_agents = 0 correctly prevented a second concurrent request while the product was still working
a fixed 180 s observation window is the binding constraint for large document jobs on this host: the product needs longer, so the run ends before the answer
this is a measurement-boundary outcome, not a product failure
honest_limits: D-04 may still deliver a late answer; it would arrive after that run's window and could not be credited to it
D-11 has not been executed at all and needs a fresh attempt at a quiescent moment
no semantic verdict is claimed for either case
